1. First letter, 3 lines

The O is large and drops beside the first 3 lines of text.

Once the rain had stopped, the boats went out again past the harbour wall, and the people on the quay watched them go until the last sail was a white mark on the grey water. Nobody spoke much. The wind had turned in the night and come round to the west, and the older men said it would hold until evening, though none of them would have put money on it.

The second paragraph has no initial. It should start at the left margin like any other paragraph, with nothing dropped beside it, and the lines above it should have wrapped around the large letter.
